تستعبدوا (form X)
# تَسْتَعْبِدُوا (tastaʕbidū) /tas.taʕ.bi.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْبَدَ (istaʕbada)
# تُسْتَعْبَدُوا (tustaʕbadū) /tus.taʕ.ba.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْبَدَ (istaʕbada)
